Container.Name: Factorio Server Control
Container.Overview: A maintained modern fork of the original Factorio Server Manager (OpenFactorioServerManager). Operate one Factorio dedicated server through a responsive web interface with independent profiles, saves, fixed checkpoints, compatible mods and dependencies, stable/experimental/exact game versions, base Factorio or Space Age, world creation, resource-aware factory-map snapshots with named platform detail, logs, users and safe server controls.
Container.Description: Factorio Server Control operates one persistent Factorio headless server through an authenticated web UI. It keeps manager state, saves, mods and configuration in explicit appdata mappings; supports independent stopped profiles; and restores the recorded exact Factorio version across container recreation. Factory-map generation can run automatically, only while no player is online, manually, without space platforms or remain fully disabled. For original-manager migration compatibility, its technical appdata root remains factorio-server-manager and its /opt/fsm-data plus /opt/factorio paths remain stable; the public product rename does not require a storage rename. Development is generative-AI-assisted and maintainer-reviewed; the deployed manager contains no AI model and sends no runtime data to AI services.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: factorio dedicated server manager mods saves space age ofsm tricade
Container.Requires: Persistent manager-data, saves, mods and config paths are required. Internet access to Factorio's official services is required for game-version installation and requested Mod Portal operations; the manager has no built-in telemetry. Keep its HTTP Web UI on a trusted LAN/VPN or behind an HTTPS reverse proxy. Split-mount recreation needs download access to restore the recorded exact game version. The image supports linux/amd64.
Container.Changes: 0.17.0: Added automatic, manual-only and disabled factory-map modes, optional idle-server and platform filters, grouped planet/platform selectors, visible platform names and sharper building footprints for compact platforms. 0.16.0: Renamed the public app to Factorio Server Control, added player and detailed factory-map views, hardened persistent deployment defaults, and reserved a three-minute clean-stop window.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the Factorio Server Control web interface.

Config.Name: Factorio Game Port
Config.Description: UDP port used by Factorio clients to connect to the game server.

Config.Name: Manager Data (required)
Config.Description: Persistent manager database, UI users, configuration, logs, credentials, profiles, checkpoints and map snapshots. Never remove this mapping during an update.

Config.Name: Mods (required)
Config.Description: Persistent downloaded mods, built-in game-mode selection and mod-list.json.

Config.Name: Config (required)
Config.Description: Persistent Factorio server and map configuration.

Config.Name: Initial Factorio Version
Config.Description: Used only for the first installation: latest, stable or an exact version such as 2.1.14. Later UI choices are persisted across container updates.

Config.Name: Secure Session Cookie
Config.Description: Use false for Unraid's direct HTTP Web UI. Set true only when the manager is always opened through an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: RCON Password
Config.Description: Optional internal Factorio RCON password. Leave empty to generate and persist a random password automatically.
